profile.headline: Software Engineer at NDX.NET
profile.summary:
Kernel, Internals, Performance, Networking, Drivers, Embedded, Bring up.

Specialties: Kernel, Wi-Fi, TCP/IP, Embedded Linux, ARM, BSPs, Android, Device Drivers, Networking Protocols.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software contractor Linux Drivers & Kernel Work.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and implemented CHAdeMO stack for ChargePoint Express level 3 EV chargers. Enhancements to support new revisions and various EV manufacturers implementations. Designed and implemented EV simulator and certification suite for testing and manufacturing. Various other projects including Linux driver debugging and firmware.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Linux Kernel performance analysis and tuning both on embedded ARM processors and AWS instances. Analysis and tuning of ARM based Set Top Box related to thermal and memory constants. AWS Service Monitoring tools (ElasticSearch, Python, Javascript & D3.js)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Support and new development for Amazon FireTV on Amazon’s custom Android/Linux Platform. Added modifications for WiFi based remotes to WiFi and USB stack. Modifications to Linux/Android Audio framework to support WiFi based ALSA driver. Modifications to Linux filesystem to dynamically partition space for critical processes.

positions.title: Principal Engineer - Software Systems
positions.description: Developed/Enhanced BSP Android/LINUX for ARM Cortex-A9 processor. Brought up Windows Mobile on new Broadcom SOC (ARM v7 core).Developed/Enhanced WiFi Drivers for (Linux/Android/MacOS/Windows/WinCE & Winmob). Developed embedded debug tools for ARM Cortex-M3 & R4. (CoreSight gdb stub, enhanced trap handling).Developed database and infrastructure to track and correlate all driver firmware builds, crashes, binaries, symbols. (MySQL). Developed backend to analyze this information. (Custom Python, TFIDF). Developed WebAPP to allow access this information. (AJAX, Jquery, Knockoutjs, JSON, Javascript, PHP, SOLR)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Contractor developing Device Drivers and Network drivers for Linux.

positions.title: Software design engineer
positions.description: MPEG Drivers for IPTV. WebTV OS and UI Development. WinCE NDIS drivers. Support and development for MicrosoftTV under Windows CE for several Set Top Box platforms (X86,MIPS,SH). Work involved issues with porting existing software to new STB hardware environments and debugging and tuning of existing device drivers in for Windows CE. Designed and implemented WIN/CE DSS tuner driver for Microsoft UltimateTV. Designed and implemented WebDAV WIN/CE filesystem/network client driver for WebTV. Debugged and tuned streaming video networking code in the WebTV client. Minor hardware level work including Audio/Video Calibration and some circuit troubleshooting (JTAG, oscilloscope, etc).

positions.title: Principal Member of the Technical Staff
positions.description: Ethernet drivers for Linux, UNIX, and Windows. NDIS, CardBUS, PCI.

positions.title: Kernel Engineer
positions.description: Designed and implemented SCO compatible Streams based Berkeley Socket interface at the UNIX Kernel level for the Interactive UNIX TCP/IP stack. Designed and developed Interactive UNIX Streams DLPI Network drivers for the SMC and 3COM EISA and PCI 100mb Network Interface cards.

positions.title: Principal Architect
positions.description: Designed PC based software protocol analyzer. Lead team of 3 developers during project development. Product supported several network driver interfaces. Product included its own integral compiler so users could define new protocols quickly (compiler was developed using YACC). Wrote protocol decode modules for TCP/IP, NFS, Netware, AppleTalk, and DECNET using the built-in compiler.

company.name: US NETWORX, INC. (West Los Angeles, CA)

positions.title: Kernel Engineer
positions.description: Ongoing development & support of network products for Interactive UNIX (SYS V Kernel). Added Jacobson slow-start algorithms to the Interactive UNIX TCP/IP stack. (This stack was based on BSD 4.3 TCP/IP stack source code). Did own performance work in the Transport to increase throughput 60%. Designed & implemented streams-based SLIP driver line discipline for the Interactive TCP/IP stack. Added BSD 4.3 symbolic links & associated system calls to the Interactive SysV 3.2 FILE SYSTEM. Developed prototype diskless workstation with another engineer (ND & NFS based). Fixed numerous bugs in the kernel as well as in the user level code.

positions.title: Kernel Engineer
positions.description: Ported IBM AIX/RT trace profiling driver to AIX PS2 Kernel. Placed all trace instrumentation in the AIX (Custom SysV/BSD4.3 Kernel). Designed & implemented new line discipline to allow RS-232 printers to be attached to normal TTY ports. Designed & implemented a new version of the parallel printer driver to use the new line discipline. Designed & implemented buffer-load simulator to test new disk algorithms. Supported most of the 386 DEVICE DRIVERS including TTY drivers , streaming tape driver, floppy disk driver, Hard disk drivers. Ported all AIX/TCF specific utilities from the 286 to the 386. Ported several BSD 4.3 utilities to AIX Kernel. Tested new compiler by rebuilding the AIX kernel with it. Provided ongoing support of UNIX utilities.

projects.title: Ported UNIX V7 to ARM
projects.description: Targeted RaspberryPI ARM Platform. Designed and implemented Virtual Memory Layout, Context Switching, System call interface, console & disk driver. Setup Build environment. GCC/GDB/QEMU. Created utilities to build system disks. Brought up kernel in single user mode. Rebuilt LibC and most of the user utilities. Currently running Borne Shell most utilities.
